list_objects.name: blender-minor_list_objects
list_objects.description: List the objects in the Blender scene (name, type, position). No arguments.

create_box.name: blender-minor_create_box
create_box.description: Create a rectangular box with exact sizes. width = X size, depth = Y size, height = Z size. x, y, z are the center of the box.

name.description: default Box

array_object.name: blender-minor_array_object
array_object.description: Repeat an existing object in a grid (Blender's Array modifier): count_x copies along X and count_y along Y, with a gap between neighbours. Use it to print many copies of a small part so each layer has time to cool. By default the copies are merged into the object, so check_mesh and export_stl see all of them. At most 400 copies.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

gap.description: space between copies (same unit as the scene), default 2

apply.description: merge the copies into the object, default true

pad.name: blender-minor_pad
pad.description: Add material on a face of an existing object, like FreeCAD's Pad: a rectangle on the face is raised by height. axis + side choose the face (Z and + is the top, the default). x1, x2, y1, y2, z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle: give only the two pairs that lie on that face (face Z: x and y; face X: y and z; face Y: x and z). Safe: a broken result leaves the object unchanged.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

height.description: how far it rises from the face

pocket.name: blender-minor_pocket
pocket.description: Cut a rectangular recess into a face of an existing object, like FreeCAD's Pocket: a rectangle on the face is cut depth deep. axis + side choose the face (Z and + is the top, the default). x1, x2, y1, y2, z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle: give only the two pairs that lie on that face (face Z: x and y; face X: y and z; face Y: x and z). Safe: a broken result leaves the object unchanged.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

depth.description: how deep it cuts into the object

drill_hole.name: blender-minor_drill_hole
drill_hole.description: Drill a round hole of an exact diameter in an existing object by name, along the X, Y or Z axis. Without depth the hole goes all the way through. With depth it is a blind hole that starts at the entry point (x, y, z) and goes into the part. Optional counterbore (a wider recess for a screw head) or countersink (a cone for a flat head).

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

countersink_diameter.description: countersink diameter at the entry (90 degree cone)

segments.description: sides of the hole, 8 to 256, default 64

pad_right.name: blender-minor_pad_right
pad_right.description: Add material on the RIGHT face (+X) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is raised by height. y1, y2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

height.description: how far it rises from the face

pocket_right.name: blender-minor_pocket_right
pocket_right.description: Cut a rectangular recess into the RIGHT face (+X) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is cut depth deep. y1, y2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

pad_left.name: blender-minor_pad_left
pad_left.description: Add material on the LEFT face (-X) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is raised by height. y1, y2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

height.description: how far it rises from the face

pocket_left.name: blender-minor_pocket_left
pocket_left.description: Cut a rectangular recess into the LEFT face (-X) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is cut depth deep. y1, y2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

pad_front.name: blender-minor_pad_front
pad_front.description: Add material on the FRONT face (-Y) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is raised by height. x1, x2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

height.description: how far it rises from the face

pocket_front.name: blender-minor_pocket_front
pocket_front.description: Cut a rectangular recess into the FRONT face (-Y) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is cut depth deep. x1, x2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

pad_back.name: blender-minor_pad_back
pad_back.description: Add material on the BACK face (+Y) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is raised by height. x1, x2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

height.description: how far it rises from the face

pocket_back.name: blender-minor_pocket_back
pocket_back.description: Cut a rectangular recess into the BACK face (+Y) of an existing object, for a part that stands up: a rectangle on that face is cut depth deep. x1, x2 and z1, z2 are the corners of the rectangle on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

nut_trap.name: blender-minor_nut_trap
nut_trap.description: Cut the hexagonal recess that holds a nut, from the TOP face of an existing object, so the nut cannot turn. size is the screw size (M2 to M8); the width across the flats and the depth come from the nut table, plus a little room.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

size.description: screw size: M2, M2.5, M3, M4, M5, M6 or M8

clearance.description: extra room around the nut, default 0.2

nut_trap_bottom.name: blender-minor_nut_trap_bottom
nut_trap_bottom.description: Cut the hexagonal recess that holds a nut, from the BOTTOM face of an existing object (the screw enters from the top and the nut sits underneath), so the nut cannot turn. size is the screw size (M2 to M8).

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

size.description: screw size: M2, M2.5, M3, M4, M5, M6 or M8

clearance.description: extra room around the nut, default 0.2

drill_hole_x.name: blender-minor_drill_hole_x
drill_hole_x.description: Drill a round hole all the way through an existing object, parallel to the X axis (from the side, for a part that stands up). y and z say where the hole is on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

drill_hole_y.name: blender-minor_drill_hole_y
drill_hole_y.description: Drill a round hole all the way through an existing object, parallel to the Y axis (from the front, for a part that stands up). x and z say where the hole is on that face.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

screw_hole.name: blender-minor_screw_hole
screw_hole.description: Drill a hole for a standard screw size by name, using a table of typical dimensions. kind: clearance (screw passes through), counterbore (plus a recess for a socket head), countersunk (plus a cone for a flat head) or insert (blind hole for a heat-set insert; needs the entry point z along the axis).

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

size.description: M2, M2.5, M3, M4, M5, M6 or M8 (default M3)

depth.description: optional: makes a clearance hole blind

check_mesh.name: blender-minor_check_mesh
check_mesh.description: Check an existing object: is the mesh closed (manifold, printable), its volume and its dimensions.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

export_stl.name: blender-minor_export_stl
export_stl.description: Export an existing object as a binary STL file for a slicer. Only a file name is accepted; the file is written to the export folder.

name.description: exact object name, as listed by list_objects

filename.description: file name, e.g. bracket.stl (default: the object name)

rows.case: question: what tools do you have (English)
rows.request: What tools do you have available? List them.
rows.model_final:
The available tools are:

1. `blender-minor_list_objects`: Lists the objects in the Blender scene.
2. `blender-minor_create_box`: Creates a rectangular box with exact sizes.
3. `blender-minor_array_object`: Repeats an object in a grid.
4. `blender-minor_pad`: Adds material on a face of an existing object.
5. `blender-minor_pocket`: Cuts a rectangular recess into a face of an existing object.
6. `blender-minor_drill_hole`: Drills a round hole in an existing object.
7. `blender-minor_pad_right`, `blender-minor_pocket_right`, `blender-minor_pad_left`, `blender-minor_pocket_left`, `blender-minor_pad_front`, `blender-minor_pocket_front`, `blender-minor_pad_back`, `blender-minor_pocket_back`: Add material or cut recesses on specific faces.
8. `blender-minor_nut_trap`, `blender-minor_nut_trap_bottom`: Creates hexagonal recesses for nuts.
9. `blender-minor_drill_hole_x`, `blender-minor_drill_hole_y`: Drills holes parallel to the X or Y axis.
10. `blender-minor_screw_hole`: Drills a hole for a standard screw.
11. `blender-minor_check_mesh`: Checks if an object's mesh is closed and printable.
12. `blender-minor_export_stl`: Exports an object as a binary STL file for a slicer.
